purpose: Defines runtime acceptance gates for Everkeep evidence delivery through GoreeCloud Mesh without converting backup existence or transport success into recoverability.
required_gates: mesh.evidence.write scope is verified by GoreeCloud Identity
delivery uses HTTPS except explicit loopback development
envelope contains no backup payloads, archive contents, credentials, or private file/message content
delivery receipt binds to the submitted evidence id
delivery receipt binds to producer_service_id everkeep
expired restore or continuity evidence remains auditable but cannot satisfy current readiness
Mesh transport success never converts backup presence into verified recovery, continuity, or preservation readiness
negative_cases: credential from an issuer other than goreecloud-identity
another producer credential attempts Everkeep delivery
envelope includes raw backup or archive contents
expired restore pass treated as current recovery readiness
